title: Early Cancellation Fee Months for Parking Licenses with a Clean Violation Record
content:
Training note on the Parking License early cancellation fee: how many months of fee a cancellation carries depends on the license's violation record and on how long the license has been held.

**The rule.** When no violation of any level was recorded on the license in the 12 months before the notice date and the license has been held at least 90 days, the fee months are 0.75; when no violation was recorded on the license in those months and the license has been held fewer than 90 days, the fee months are 0.9; in every other case the fee months are the product's early cancellation fee months.

**What counts as a violation here?** Any violation recorded on the license in the 12 months before the notice date, whatever the enforcement step taken — a warning, a fine or a tow.

**How is "held" measured?** In days from the license's start date to the notice date.

**Which fee months apply?**

| Violations recorded on the license in the 12 months before the notice date | Days held | Fee months |
|---|---|---|
| none | 90 or more | 0.75 |
| none | fewer than 90 | 0.9 |
| one or more, of any level | any | the product's early cancellation fee months |

**Boundary cases (hypothetical licenses with no violation in the window).** Held 90 days: 0.75. Held 89 days: 0.9. A single warning recorded 11 months before the notice date takes the license out of both of the first two rows.
